page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 52 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 52 physical cores, with hyperthreading disabled at 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. Because the 52 vCPUs are dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, the instance offers highly predictable compute performance, eliminating resource contention issues typical of shared-thread architectures. This design makes it suitable for workloads sensitive to CPU cache thrashing or those that do not benefit from simultaneous multithreading.

In terms of resource density, the ecs.re6p.13xlarge balances a high physical core count with a moderate memory allocation, positioning it as a cost-efficient option for parallel processing tasks that require dedicated CPU execution units rather than massive memory footprints. However, the lack of local storage means all disk I/O relies on network-attached volumes, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for storage-heavy operations. This hardware profile is appropriate for parallel processing, batch processing, scientific simulations, and CPU-bound general-purpose workloads.
